grounding.states: 2023 YouGov poll: 22% of Americans love pineapple on pizza and 37% like it, about 59% like or love it
grounding.from: YouGov poll, March 2023: 22% of Americans love pineapple on pizza, 37% like it

grounding.states: 2017 Slice app survey: 54% said pineapple does not belong on pizza
grounding.from: Slice app survey, 2017: 54% of respondents said pineapple does not belong on pizza

value.answer: Yes, it's ok. I'm firmly on the yes side. It's a split one, though. A 2023 YouGov poll had about 59% of Americans liking or loving it, but a 2017 Slice survey had 54% saying it doesn't belong on pizza. Taste wins here, so eat what you like.
